texts:
Sunday's early games cost three contenders a star by halftime.

Lamar Jackson hurt his ankle.

Saquon Barkley hurt his hamstring.

Ja'Marr Chase has a concussion.

Monitor all three; Wednesday's practice reports.

Let's get into it.
#RavensFlock #FlyEaglesFly #WhoDey

Lamar Jackson was 15 of 20 for 222 and two touchdowns vs TEN before a sack on the last play of the half hurt his ankle. Jesse Minter calls him day-to-day.

QB2 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.
#RavensFlock #TitanUp

Tyler Huntley finished Baltimore's 24-18 win over Tennessee. Leave him on the wire until Jackson's status is known.

Zay Flowers played through the hamstring. WR11 rest of season for me; hold him.
#RavensFlock #TitanUp

Saquon Barkley hurt his right hamstring on a 6-yard run in the first quarter vs LAR and was ruled out before halftime. He walked out of the stadium normally after the loss.

RB8 rest of season for me; hold him. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.
#FlyEaglesFly #RamsHouse

Tank Bigsby took 14 carries for 55 yards after Barkley left, then needed help off late. Claim him, 5 to 10 percent of FAAB.

Will Shipley ran 6 times for 23. Leave him on the wire.
#FlyEaglesFly

Ja'Marr Chase left in the second quarter vs JAX with a concussion after a facemask tackle, at 3 catches for 27.

WR1 rest of season for me. Monitor; the concussion protocol and Wednesday's practice report.
#WhoDey #DUUUVAL

Tee Higgins caught 11 for 157 once Chase was gone in the 22-17 loss to Jacksonville. WR16 rest of season for me; hold him.

Joe Burrow threw 54 times for 428. QB5 rest of season; hold.
#WhoDey #DUUUVAL

DJ Moore left Buffalo's 29-26 loss to New England late in the second quarter with the shoulder that also knocked him out in Week 2. WR24 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

Khalil Shakir is WR53 rest of season; no move yet.
#BillsMafia #NEPats

Mack Hollins left New England's win with a non-contact calf injury after 3 catches for 53. He led the team in targets through three games. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

Efton Chism had two catches all year before the winning score. Leave him be.
#NEPats #BillsMafia

Drake Maye was 22 of 37 for 269 and three touchdowns in the upset at BUF, with 54 rushing yards. QB10 rest of season for me; hold him.
#NEPats #BillsMafia

Mike Evans is active vs DEN after a week of side work with the ribs. WR25 rest of season for me; hold him through the ribs.

George Kittle is TE3 for me this week.
#FTTB #BroncosCountry

Ladd McConkey is active @SEA with the foot after a limited Friday. WR39 for me this week, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.

Emanuel Wilson leads Seattle's backfield with Jadarian Price on IR. RB31 for me, a low-end RB3.
#BoltUp #Seahawks

Terry McLaurin sat out London vs IND with the hamstring he hurt in Friday's practice. WR29 rest of season for me; hold him.

Stefon Diggs is WR30 rest of season; hold.
#RaiseHail #ForTheShoe

Tyjae Spears played through the ankle @BAL. RB48 rest of season for me; a bench hold.

Tony Pollard had 80 percent of Tennessee's early downs in Week 3. RB31 rest of season, a flex play.
#TitanUp #RavensFlock

Kenyon Sadiq played through the back @CHI with New York's starting tight end inactive. TE22 rest of season for me; stream him only while that injury lasts.

Braelon Allen had the backfield with Breece Hall out. RB20 for me this week, an RB2.
#JetUp #DaBears

Xavier Legette is on IR with the knee. Drop him.

Jalen Coker (quad) is unlikely to play vs DET tonight. Monitor; the inactives at 6:50 PM ET.

Tetairoa McMillan is WR12 for me, borderline WR1/WR2.
#KeepPounding #OnePride

Every note from Sunday is on the Pass page, with the injury calls that shape Week 5.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for Monday's leftovers and Tuesday's waiver calls, and send this to your league chat.
